messages.«Через диск» — медленнее (данные временн:
“On disk” — slower (data is written to disk for a while), uses almost no RAM, needs free disk space about twice the uncompressed archive, and stops within seconds on Esc (you see the step: writing/compressing/assembling).

“In memory” — faster, needs free RAM about the size of the uncompressed archive, but can HARDLY BE STOPPED midway — Esc/“Cancel” only stop waiting and drop the result when it finishes, which can take long.

messages.\n<h2>Генерация SDF-шрифтов</h2>\n<p>Есл:
Generating SDF fonts

If SDF fonts lack the letters you need, you can add them or replace the whole font by generating SDF from .ttf / .otf files.

WayWhen it fits
1. By handTo try generation out, find the best settings, or a quick replacement.
2. With a mapping fileFor replacing many fonts automatically, each with its own settings.

1. By hand

  1. In the table, select a MonoBehaviour object whose “Script” column says “TMP_FontAsset”. You can select several with Ctrl or Shift + click.
  2. Right-click and choose “Generate SDF...”.
  3. Set what you need, click “Generate”, then “Save”.

Note: there is no preview for several fonts at once: “OK” starts the generation and applies the changes right away.

2. With a mapping file

  1. Prepare a sdf_map.txt file with the settings (see below).
  2. Put the vector fonts, sdf_map.txt and, if you like, chars.txt into one folder.
  3. Right-click any object in the table, choose “Import into environment...” and pick that folder.
  4. Generation starts by itself, or you are first asked for the default generation settings.

Note: “Import into environment...” first applies the ordinary patch files in the folder (if any), then generates SDF by the map (if there is one).
messages.Насколько резкими или мягкими получаются:
How sharp or soft the letters' edges are.

A smaller value gives sharper, less smoothed edges (good for pixel and retro fonts). A larger one gives a softer, smoother edge.

Only in the “Full replacement” mode.
messages.Эти настройки применяются только к тем ш:
These settings apply only to fonts that sdf_map.txt does not set them for (neither in the font's own line nor in the “default:” line).

Whatever the file says wins over what you choose here.
messages.Добавление новых символов — пропускает с:
Add new characters — skips characters the font already has and adds only new ones. Nothing existing is touched or rebuilt.

Replace + add characters — rebuilds the listed characters the font already has, adds the others (the font's other characters stay as they are).

Full replacement — removes every character of the SDF font and generates from scratch. The texture size is chosen automatically and grows if the characters don't fit.
messages.Размер букв при создании.\n\n«Исходный»:
The letters' size when generating.

“Original” — as the font has now. “Custom” — your own size.

“Fit the texture” — the largest size at which every character fits the current atlas; if they don't fit, the texture grows.

Only in the “Full replacement” mode.
messages.Добавляет в пресет недостающие символы и:
Adds the SDF font's own characters that the preset lacks, so no squares appear instead of letters. A character the vector font doesn't have is skipped.

Only in the “Full replacement” mode.
messages.Подбирает масштаб так, чтобы новые симво: Scales the new characters so they look as tall in the game as the old ones. Useful when the new font is noticeably smaller or larger. The texture size stays the same. The line height is taken from the original too, and the extra spacing of bold text is turned off so lines don't get wider and wrap.
messages.Подогнать высоту букв под оригинал: Match the letters' height to the original
messages.Добавлять недостающие символы из SDF шри: Add the SDF font's missing characters

messages.Если в разных подпапках найдены файлы с:
If files with the same name are found in different subfolders (e.g. “level0” of different games), all of them are loaded. References inside the files find the right one by its full path.

The setting below matters when a file is looked up by name only (without a folder):
• By default the first file found is used.
• “Stop loading”: stops at the first same-named file.

To skip folders you don't need entirely, add them to the exclusion list below.
